q_45367.question_text: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release? (Revenue)
q_45367.reasoning:
# Analysis of NVIDIA Q2 FY2027 Forward Guidance

## (a) Time left until resolution

Q2 FY2027 ends July 26, 2026. Today is August 21, 2026. The earnings release and forward guidance would typically occur within days of quarter-end (early-to-mid August 2026). **This event has likely already occurred or is imminent** — we are essentially at or past the resolution date. The forward guidance for Q2 has almost certainly been publicly stated by now.

However, I will proceed assuming the question seeks the guidance number that was/will be released for Q2 FY2027.

## (b) Most likely outcome and why

**The most likely forward guidance for Q3 FY2027 revenue (which is what management would announce in the Q2 earnings release) is in the range of $100-105 billion.**

Key facts from the research:
- NVIDIA guided Q2 FY2027 revenue to **$91.0 billion ± 2%** (so $89.2B–$92.8B range) in its Q1 earnings on May 20, 2026
- Wall Street consensus for Q2 FY2027 was **$91.9 billion** ($91.85B in one source)
- Q1 FY2027 actual revenue was **$81.6 billion**, beating guidance by ~$2 billion
- Wall Street consensus for Q3 FY2027 is **$103.1 billion** as of August 12-13, 2026

The question asks for "forward guidance" in the Q2 earnings release. This would be guidance for **Q3 FY2027**, not Q2 itself. Management typically guides one quarter ahead.

Given the strong beat in Q1 ($81.6B vs ~$79.6B guided), the pattern suggests NVIDIA may guide conservatively but with upside potential. The consensus for Q3 is $103.1B, suggesting Wall Street expects ~13% sequential growth from Q2 to Q3.

## (c) What would push the value lower?

- **Weakening demand signals**: If macro conditions deteriorated significantly between Q2 earnings and the guidance call, management might guide more conservatively below consensus
- **China restrictions tightening**: The research notes China Data Center compute revenue is excluded; additional regulatory restrictions could constrain guidance
- **Inventory corrections**: If customer inventory levels rose unexpectedly, management might guide lower
- **Conservative guidance anchoring**: NVIDIA has shown a pattern of beating guidance; they might guide at or slightly below consensus ($100–101B) to set up beats

## (d) What would push the value higher?

- **Continued momentum**: If Q2 beat guidance significantly (as Q1 did), management might guide above Wall Street consensus
- **AI demand acceleration**: Sustained or accelerating AI investment could push guidance toward the high end ($104–106B)
- **Better-than-expected bookings**: Strong customer orders during Q2 might justify higher Q3 guidance
- **Upside surprise in results**: If Q2 revenue exceeded the $91B guidance materially, management might lift Q3 guidance accordingly

## (e) Base rate or historical reference values

From the research provided:
- **Q1 FY2027 actual**: $81.6 billion
- **Q2 FY2027 guidance**: $91.0 billion ± 2% (range: $89.2B–$92.8B)
- **Q2 FY2027 Wall Street consensus**: $91.9 billion
- **Q3 FY2027 Wall Street consensus**: $103.1 billion (as of Aug 12-13, 2026)
- **Q1 beat**: ~$2 billion above guidance

The implied sequential growth from Q2 guidance ($91.0B) to Q3 consensus ($103.1B) is 13.3%. This seems reasonable given NVIDIA's trajectory.

---

## Reasoning toward point estimate

The question asks for "forward guidance in Q2 FY2027 earnings release" for "Revenue." This is guidance given **in** the Q2 earnings call, which would be guidance **for Q3 FY2027**.

Given:
1. Wall Street consensus for Q3 is $103.1 billion
2. NVIDIA has historically guided conservatively relative to consensus
3. Q1 beat by ~$2 billion, suggesting underlying strength
4. The range provided (99.5–115.5B) is very wide, accommodating significant upside or downside

**Most likely scenario**: NVIDIA guides to approximately $102–104 billion for Q3 FY2027, close to or slightly below Wall Street consensus of $103.1B.

The median should reflect:
- Strong likelihood near consensus: $103.1B
- Some risk of more conservative guidance below consensus
- Some risk of above-consensus guidance if Q2 beat significantly

**My estimate**:
- **Low (10th percentile)**: ~$100.5B (conservative guidance, macro concerns)
- **Median (50th percentile)**: ~$103.0B (aligned with consensus)
- **High (90th percentile)**: ~$105.5B (strong beat in Q2 lifts outlook)

q_45367.research_text:
NVIDIA's forward guidance for Q3 FY2027 revenue is a critical point of interest. Wall Street analysts, as of August 12-13, 2026, anticipate a consensus revenue of $103.1 billion for Q3 FY2027 [rexshares.com](https://www.rexshares.com/nvidia-earnings/).

For Q2 FY2027, which ends July 26, NVIDIA previously guided revenue to $91.0 billion, plus or minus 2%, in its May 20, 2026, Q1 FY2027 earnings release [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/). This guidance explicitly excludes any Data Center compute revenue from China [fool.com](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/19/nvidia-guided-to-usd91-billion-wall-street-penciled-in-usd92-billion/). Wall Street's average estimate for Q2 FY2027 revenue is slightly higher at $91.9 billion [fool.com](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/19/nvidia-guided-to-usd91-billion-wall-street-penciled-in-usd92-billion/), or $91.85 billion [rexshares.com](https://www.rexshares.com/nvidia-earnings/). In Q1 FY2027, NVIDIA reported $81.6 billion in revenue, exceeding its own guidance by approximately $2 billion [fool.com](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/19/nvidia-guided-to-usd91-billion-wall-street-penciled-in-usd92-billion/).
